diagnosis: Alumnos already has a six-route Student World José candidate and an independent static VERIFIED review. The remaining browser verification lane requires a representative JavaScript browser unavailable in this runtime, so duplicating browser jobs would add no usable frontier. A non-browser review handoff for this exact extension did not exist.
intervention: Materialized one grounded implementation job that turns the producer/static-review evidence into an isolated static review handoff with exact identities, six-route inventory, STATIC_VERIFIED_BROWSER_PENDING truth state and explicit no-promotion boundaries.
